Srikant Panda Bangalore, India

+91-9743062256 srikant86.panda@gmail.com

Summary

Applied Scientist | 14+ years in NLP, VLMs, LLMs & Document AI. Skilled in building AI solutions, integrating multi-modal data, and driving business impact through R&D. Thrives in fast-paced, collaborative environments, embracing rapid experimentation to accelerate innovation. Proven leadership in mentoring and contributions to patents/publications. Focused on ensuring trustworthy model robustness, delivering reliable and ethical AI systems.

Awards & Recognitions

Social Impact Award - Accesseval a benchmark evaluating disability boas in LLMs (EMNLP 2025). • Awarded for innovation in AI/ML through building a hybrid recommendation system delivering exceptional CTR and engagement, surpassing Google AutoML performance (Vuclip 2019).

Work Experience

Current Employer: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Designation: Senior Applied Scientist Key Responsibilities: • Claim Processing Engine - Build a scalable claim processing engine leveraging LangGraph. • Responsible AI Programs - Accessibility ML practices & engineered prompt-injection mitigations guardrail system. • LLM & VLM Research - Leading Generative AI R&D, developing LLM and VLM models with PyTorch & Hugging Face to

(May 21- Sep 25)

address enterprise AI challenges, optimizing scalability and efficiency.

Multi-Modal & Graph-Based AI for Document Intelligence - Developing AI-driven approaches for document understanding by integrating multi-modal deep learning with Transformer and graph neural networks (GNNs).

Data Preprocessing & Synthetic Data Generation - Spearheaded data curation, augmentation, and multi-modal dataset creation for Vision & NLP tasks, improving model generalization.

Model Trustworthiness & AI Ethics - Established methodologies for AI fairness, robustness, and transparency. • Mentorship & Technical Leadership - Guided and onboarded researchers in LLM architectures, fostering innovation and driving best practices in AI model development.

Key Projects & Achievements: • Face Recognition and Anti-Spoofing - Achieved close to SOTA performance with face recognition and antispoofing.

Lead internal data collection and annotation efforts that saved $400,000 in operational costs.

Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Framework - Built an intelligent routing mechanism to optimize QA system efficiency, reducing latency.

Generative AI for Code Generation - Developed an LLM for SuiteScript code generation using StarCoderBase, leveraging parameter-efficient fine-tuning to enhance adaptability

Document Understanding & Key-Value Extraction - Developed Oracle Cloud’s CustomKV extraction, DL extraction achieving industry parity with Azure and surpassing Google Document AI Custom Model.

Data Generation Framework - Designed a multi-modal data-generation pipeline, enabling multi-task learning for Vision & NLP models, boosting overall performance.

Recent Employer: TVS Motor Company Designation: Principal Data Scientist • Developed and implemented a transformer-based recommendation module capable of detecting duplicate queries

(Oct 20- Apr 2021)

with 92% accuracy, leading to a 20% reduction in service team workload.

Past Employer: Vuclip (VIU) Designation: Principal Engineer • Hybrid Recommendation System: Engineered a hybrid recommendation model combining collaborative and content-

(June 18- Sept 20)

based filtering, achieving best-in-class CTR and engagement metrics.

Subscription Fraud Detection: Reduced fraud leveraging local and global user behavior data.

Past Employer: NASDAQ India, on behalf of Tech Mahindra

(June 17- May 18)

Designation: Technical Lead, Data Analytics

Sentiment Analysis for Market Data: Built stock market sentiment models for real-time bullish/bearish predictions.

Past Employer: Philips India (Includes two years of Integra Micro System's deputation) Designation: Data Specialist, Senior Software Engineer, Software Engineer

(Jan 10- May 17)

• Sentiment Analysis: Built classification models for app store reviews, driving actionable customer feedback

Patents & Research Contribution

Accepted Conference Papers:

A Diagnostic Framework for Auditing Reference-Free Vision-Language Metrics (AACL-IJCNLP 2025, Mumbai) • AccessEval: Benchmarking Disability Bias in Large Language Models (EMNLP 2025, Suzhou) • • RCI: A Score for Evaluating Global and Local Reasoning in Multimodal Benchmarks (EMNLP 2025, Suzhou) • FlexDoc: Parameterized Sampling for Diverse Multilingual Synthetic Documents for Training Document Understanding Models (EMNLP 2025, Suzhou)

PCRI: Measuring Context Robustness in Multimodal Models for Enterprise Applications (EMNLP 2025, Suzhou)
